name: ad-sync-single-user
description: AD Sync Single-User Lambda — event-driven sync

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild ./*.mjs --entry-names=./[name] --bundle --minify --sourcemap --platform=node --target=node20.16 --format=cjs --outdir=dist --external:@aws-sdk/* --external:ldapjs && cp -rL node_modules dist/node_modules
